verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Outlook can be self-hosted or that users can run their own mail pipeline. The Graph mail API, Inbox rules and change notifications are cloud-service developer building blocks tied to Exchange Online, which is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
